description_en: Invokes the DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries operation to query the route entries of a network instance in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries接口查询云企业网中网络实例的路由条目信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-child-instance-route-entries --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnvo0000 --child-instance-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

VBR: virtual border router (VBR).

CCN: Cloud Connect Network (CCN).

ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例。

VPN：VPN网关实例。

ECR：专线网关实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

Active: active.

Candidate: candidate.

Rejected: rejected.

Prohibited: prohibited.

All (default): queries route entries in all states of the network instance
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：

Active：可用。

Candidate：备份。

Rejected：拒绝。

Prohibited：禁止。

All（默认值）：表示查询网络实例下所有状态的路由条目信息
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The routing table ID of the network instance.
If you do not specify a routing table ID when querying route entries of a VPC-connected instance, the system queries route entries in the system routing table of the VPC-connected instance by default
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的路由表ID。
在您查询VPC实例路由表下的路由条目信息时，如果您不指定路由表ID，系统默认查询VPC实例系统路由表下的路由条目信息
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

AsPath.description_en: The list of AS Path attribute values of the route entry
AsPath.description_zh: 路由条目的AS Path属性值列表

items.description_en: The AS Path attribute value of the route entry
items.description_zh: 路由条目的AS Path属性值

CenRouteMapRecord.description_en: The routing policy information matched by the route entry
CenRouteMapRecord.description_zh: 路由条目匹配到的路由策略信息

RegionId.description_en: The region ID where the routing policy is applied

Community.description_en: The list of Community attribute values of the route entry
Community.description_zh: 路由条目的Community属性值列表

items.description_en: The Community attribute value of the route entry

Conflict.description_en: The information about the conflicting route entry
Conflict.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目信息

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the conflicting route entry
DestinationCidrBlock.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目的目标网段

InstanceId.description_en: The network instance ID of the peer that has the conflicting routing entry
InstanceId.description_zh: 产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例ID

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the peer network instance that has the conflicting route entry. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).
VBR: virtual border router (VBR).
CCN: Cloud Connect Network (CCN).
ECR: Express Connect Router (ECR)
InstanceType.description_zh:
产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网。
ECR：专线网关

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the peer network instance that has the conflicting route entry
RegionId.description_zh: 产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例所属地域ID

Status.description_en:
The cause of the route entry conflict. Valid values:

conflict: The route entries have the same destination CIDR block.  
         
overflow: The number of route entries in the route table of another network instance exceeds the limit
Status.description_zh:
路由条目产生冲突的原因。取值：

conflict：路由条目的目标网段相同造成的冲突。  
         
overflow：其他网络实例路由表的路由条目数量超出限制造成的冲突。

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

NextHopInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance associated with the next hop of the routing entry
NextHopInstanceId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的实例ID

NextHopRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance associated with the next hop of the route entry
NextHopRegionId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的实例所属的地域ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The next hop type of the route entry. Valid values:

Instance: ECS instance.
HaVip: high availability (HA) virtual IP address (HAVIP).
RouterInterface: router interface.
NetworkInterface: elastic network interface (ENI).
VpnGateway: VPN gateway.
IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.
Ipv4Gateway: IPv4 gateway.
NatGateway: NAT gateway.
Attachment: network instance connection.
service: cloud service.
VBR: virtual border router (VBR).
CCN: Cloud Connect Network (CCN).
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).
local: The current route entry is a system route of the network instance and has no next hop.
TR: transit router.
BlackHole: The current route entry is a blackhole route and has no next hop.
EcRouterInterface: Express Connect router interface.
HealthCheck: health check.
AS: CCN access gateway.
classicLink: classic network instance.
GatewayEndpoint: gateway endpoint.
CPE: on-premises data center connected to the VBR
NextHopType.description_zh:
路由条目下一跳类型。取值：

Instance：ECS实例。
HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。
RouterInterface：路由器接口。
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。
VpnGateway：VPN网关。
IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
NatGateway：NAT网关。
Attachment：网络实例连接。
service：云服务。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网。
VPC：专有网络。
local：表示当前路由条目为网络实例的系统路由，没有下一跳。
TR：转发路由器。
BlackHole：表示当前路由条目为黑洞路由，没有下一跳。
EcRouterInterface：高速通道路由器接口。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AS：云连接网接入网关。
classicLink：经典网络实例。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
CPE：边界路由器连接的本地数据中心

OperationalMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the route entry can be published to or withdrawn from CEN. Valid values:
true: The route entry can be published or withdrawn.

false: The route entry cannot be published or withdrawn
OperationalMode.description_zh:
是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网。取值：
true：允许发布或撤销。

false：不允许发布或撤销

PublishStatus.description_en:
The publish status of the route entry in CEN. Valid values:

Published: published.

NonPublished: not published
PublishStatus.description_zh:
路由条目在云企业网中的发布状态。取值：

Published：已发布。

NonPublished：未发布

Status.description_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

Active: active.

Candidate: candidate.

Rejected: rejected.

Prohibited: prohibited
Status.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：

Active：可用。

Candidate：备份。

Rejected：拒绝。

Prohibited：禁止

Type.description_en:
The destination type of the route entry. Valid values:

CEN: a route entry propagated through CEN.
System: a system route.
Custom: a custom route
Type.description_zh:
路由条目的类型。取值：

CEN：表示通过云企业网传递的路由。
System：表示系统路由。
Custom：表示自定义路由

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数
